title: The place where the nearest people are in space

story.headline: The place where the nearest people are *in space*

post.title: Point Nemo: the spot where the nearest humans are in space 🛰️
post.premise: There is a spot in the Pacific where the closest humans are usually the ones in orbit
post.bait: Could you handle being 2,700 km from anyone? 👇
post.description:
In the South Pacific there is a point so far from any coast that the people passing overhead on the space station are often closer than anyone on land. This map story measures the distance to the three nearest specks of land, draws the empty circle around it, and shows why space agencies steer their dead spacecraft here on purpose.
Could you handle being that far from anyone? Tell us below.
